notes.title: Bug reporting via Discord possible!
notes.content:
Hey Beefans,

Thank you for all your feedback on Beefense Beemastered. 

Recently, however, a few bugs have appeared that we would like to get rid of as quickly as possible. We would like to offer you two different ways to do this:

1.) On the one hand you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/jzBVVfQPuZ] Discord [/url] to report bugs. Under the text channel "🐞bugs" you can simply report a bug to us with the command !bug. 

2.) On the other hand, if you don't want to go the Discord way, you can also report bugs in the game under the discussion tab [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1640930/discussions/1/] Bugs and Feedback [/url] on Steam.


Good defending,

Byterockers‘ Games
